The local pre-push check follows, then the operator pass.

Absences, each with its reason: - No boot-smoke entry: no file of the chunk is on the boot-smoke trigger list (test-plan §3 Per-chunk gate   discipline), and the chunk boots no app. - No webview gates, no headful self-verify, no `cargo xtask test:a11y`: no `pulse-app/ui/**` path changes and no   rendered surface does. The `a11y` job is read on the CI run. - No liveness probe and no live leg: the chunk drives no external process and binds no port. - No targeted nextest entry: steps 0 and 5 run the pins as the red-before-green pair   (`cargo nextest run --workspace --profile ci -E 'binary(quality_gate_workflow) + package(xtask)'`); the workspace   nextest entry runs the same tests on every re-run. - Step 5's four mutations edit a file and restore it, so each is a one-shot run at implement; the workspace nextest   entry guards the four properties on every re-run.

**The operator pass, in this order.** The hygiene entry, the pre-CI commit, the local pre-push entry again, the merge-base probe, the push; then the whole pull-request run of the pushed tip is read. Five reads by that run's id, as `<id>`, follow: the run's artifact names, the count of read-nothing lines across its six job logs, the coverage step's own lines, the `ci-gates` step's own lines, and the quarantine check's line with the test selections. The last entry lists every job, report-only. A red merge-base probe goes to the operator before any push. No run is re-run to obtain a green. A self-end in the boot job's series step is a new reading, brought to the operator.
